notes: In-host samples (glnG mutant from mouse cecal mucus): in_host, not_applicable, mixed_organism true, no treatment. In vitro MOPS glucose with 10 mM (high N) or 3 mM NH4Cl (low N, 'N-lim'). WT untreated in vitro samples (low-N exponential, high-N stationary) are controls. StrR marker ignored.
